c8bcefee-c64a-5a1f-911c-502cc4522701.content: Link each HCI research question directly to corresponding user data and analysis procedures.

8747b27e-6c2b-5498-9eac-c403e26101a6.content: In preregistered studies, specify the conditions under which deviations from the plan are permissible.

c3ad4ad8-4c5c-54c5-8d65-2dae15fa69a0.content: In preregistered studies, specify how to record content that deviates from the plan.

df53a41c-2fbf-532a-a5b0-560a196bf5cb.content: Commit to one exact target number of participants so the schedule, workload, and budget can be checked against the same quantity.

24d49198-fd7b-5810-bc56-1910a796f76e.content: Specify the interview protocols, recording devices, or log tools used to collect each type of user data.

2f367cf3-50c5-59bc-972e-6173e56343ac.content: Specify whether each type of user data is collected before, during, or after the interaction.

91db3bd1-4417-5db6-b7a6-3e79c87ebe88.content: Readers cannot tell whether the schedule and budget agree when different sections imply different target counts.

49746579-92d7-51ea-b158-7d770443d101.content: In formative evaluation prototypes, implementation instability exists as an independent cause of task failure alongside design choices.

20d116ab-f9cc-5f61-808b-8555da09d707.content: If a prototype safety signal occurs during formative evaluation, existing institutional safety procedures take precedence over planned data collection.

881bc037-c099-50e4-b7e0-d38fba5146c9.content: Reviewers judge answerability by tracing the path from each research question to the data and analysis.

9a969676-6093-5fac-bda8-92ebdac70c37.content: The author of this proposal tends to present implemented feature lists directly as design contributions.

0ecc319a-ae60-5510-883d-52e613138164.content: Calculate the required sessions, facilitator hours, and participant payments from the same exact target rather than from separate rough estimates.

c4dfdb65-e673-52c0-a40c-e909d6014e00.content: If recruitment falls below the exact target, state the shortfall explicitly and revise the affected schedule or deliverable.

a7c3a123-3f05-52e0-b33e-c450d1a070ac.content: Do not use a wide range merely to postpone choosing the quantity that the rest of the proposal must support.
